name: SongWars IV
headline: Free For All
summary: Solo artists and first-time SongWars judges can express interest. Winner gets a prize.
interestNote: Submitting the interest form does not reserve a bracket spot. The date and selection details are still to come.

communityNote: Moderators and spectators can follow the rollout on Discord.
